name: fix_go_channel_deadlock
description: Fixes a worker/channel pattern that deadlocks on an unbuffered channel
prompts: Process in pool.go deadlocks: the workers send into an UNBUFFERED channel that nothing reads until after wg.Wait(), so every worker blocks on its send, Wait never returns, and the runtime kills the program with 'all goroutines are asleep - deadlock!'. Fix pool.go so Process returns every doubled item (order doesn't matter) without deadlocking - buffer the channel to len(items), or drain it concurrently with a collector goroutine; either idiom is fine. Keep the signature.
